title: Little dragon dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='17' ry='20' fill='#3fbf5f'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='12' ry='15' fill='#7ff09a'/>
  <!-- Belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='9' ry='12' fill='#f7e07a'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='15' fill='#3fbf5f'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='36' r='11' fill='#7ff09a'/>
  <!-- Snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='43' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#f7e07a'/>
  <!-- Nostrils -->
  <circle cx='47' cy='42' r='1.2' fill='#c9a63a'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='42' r='1.2' fill='#c9a63a'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='32' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='32' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='33' r='2.2' fill='#2a6fd6'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='33' r='2.2' fill='#2a6fd6'/>
  <!-- Horns -->
  <polygon points='40,21 44,10 47,22' fill='#f7e07a'/>
  <polygon points='60,21 56,10 53,22' fill='#f7e07a'/>
  <!-- Left wing (raised, dancing) -->
  <path d='M34,55 C18,38 8,30 12,50 C6,46 4,62 16,64 C20,66 28,62 34,55 Z' fill='#5ad0f0'/>
  <path d='M30,57 C20,48 14,44 16,56' stroke='#bff0ff' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Right wing (down) -->
  <path d='M66,56 C82,50 92,52 86,66 C92,64 90,76 78,76 C72,76 68,66 66,56 Z' fill='#5ad0f0'/>
  <path d='M70,58 C80,56 86,58 84,66' stroke='#bff0ff' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Dancing arms -->
  <path d='M36,58 C26,50 22,44 24,40' stroke='#3fbf5f' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M64,58 C74,52 80,52 82,48' stroke='#3fbf5f' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Legs (one kicked up) -->
  <path d='M44,80 C42,88 36,90 34,92' stroke='#3fbf5f' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M56,80 C60,86 66,86 70,84' stroke='#3fbf5f' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='93' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#f7e07a'/>
  <ellipse cx='71' cy='84' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#f7e07a'/>
  <!-- Tail with spade -->
  <path d='M62,78 C74,80 80,74 82,68' stroke='#3fbf5f' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <polygon points='82,68 88,60 84,74 90,70' fill='#f7e07a'/>
  <!-- Back spines -->
  <polygon points='44,18 50,8 56,18' fill='#f7e07a' opacity='0.9'/>
  <!-- Musical notes to show dancing -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='24' r='3' fill='#ff8ad0'/>
  <rect x='22.2' y='12' width='1.8' height='12' fill='#ff8ad0'/>
  <path d='M24,12 L30,14 L30,17 L24,15 Z' fill='#ff8ad0'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='30' r='2.5' fill='#ffd24a'/>
  <rect x='81.8' y='20' width='1.6' height='10' fill='#ffd24a'/>
</svg>
